comment: Pinned SHA-256 of the trained model files (too large for git). scripts/fetch_models.py downloads them from the release named in 'release' (if set), else the latest release, else the bench run artefacts below, and verifies every hash. Update after a bench run that retrains a model; once a release carries these files, set 'release' to its tag.

family_model.npz.what: Avast-CTU family model (behaviour+static hashed LR; weights identical to the v1.1.0 asset)

family_meta.json.what: family model metadata: classes, variant and abstain threshold, both selected on the temporal validation slice

static_lgbm.txt.what: EMBER LightGBM gate (triage-ember): temporal model, train 2018-01..09, threshold for 99 % recall on 2018-10 (seed 0 of results/static_ember_temporal.json)
